programMetadata.trainingSplit: 4 true training days / 8 separate AM-PM sessions / 3 recovery days

codexProgressionRules.title: RE-ENTRY
codexProgressionRules.rawRule: Rebuild tolerance, technique, and consistency; use controlled loads and avoid grinders.

codexProgressionRules.title: DELOAD
codexProgressionRules.rawRule: Reduce normal lifting/accessory set volume approximately 30–40%. Reduce jump/acceleration volume approximately 50% while retaining movement quality.

codexProgressionRules.title: BUILD
codexProgressionRules.rawRule: Progress load, reps, skill quality, assistance level, or execution according to the existing exercise prescriptions without changing the programmed structure.

codexProgressionRules.title: CONSOLIDATION / TEST
codexProgressionRules.rawRule: Assess body metrics, muscle-up progress, pulling strength, planche, handstand, HSPU, L-sit, grip, jumps, acceleration, and major strength movements without grinder 1RMs.

nonNegotiables: AM and PM workouts remain separate Lift Ghost sessions/Tomes.
A missed AM does not automatically merge the full AM Tome into PM.
Only explicitly prescribed abbreviated missed-AM work may be inserted into the corresponding PM Tome.
Do not invent additional missed-AM substitutions where the finalized source does not prescribe one.
Weeks 1–3 use controlled loads and avoid grinders.
Week 4 deload reduces normal lifting/accessory set volume approximately 30–40% and jump/acceleration volume approximately 50%, while retaining movement quality.
Weeks 5–7 progress within the existing exercise prescriptions without changing the programmed structure.
On normal training days, complete the final exercise by approximately 6:00 PM.
Recovery work remains restorative and does not become another training day.
45° Back Extension is conditional on the station being available.

missedAMMergeRules.rawRule: If Monday Day 1 AM is missed, insert only the prescribed abbreviated work before Day 1 PM. Do not merge the full AM Tome.

If Tuesday Day 2 AM is missed, insert only Band-Assisted Muscle-Up 3 × 2 and High Pull-Up 3 × 3 before Day 2 PM. Drop Strict Pull-Ups, Dead Hangs, and Straight-Bar Dips from the missed-AM merge. Do not merge the full AM Tome.
